items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Warren Luckey... didn't spend too long a time in the band... And Parker was in the band then

ctx.x: Anyway, this filling station welcomed us and everything and we filled up and while we were there a couple of the guys said, I'm going across and get a sandwich and I said okay and they went on across and we got through and had washed up, used the bathroom, filled up and everything and we were all sitting in the bus. We had two or three pistols in the bus; I used to carry my shotgun (inaudible) and Warren Luckey, I don't know if you ever knew him, a very nice musician, but he didn't spend too long a time in the…
